# Arrange Master

Arrange Master is a true-shape nesting and layout plugin for Adobe Illustrator on Windows and macOS.

## Current licenses

Prices are in USD and are one-time purchases, not subscriptions. All three licenses include the same plugin features; usage rights and device limits differ.

- Personal License: $39; 1 activated device. Personal use and freelance client projects.
- Team License: $79; up to 3 activated devices. Commercial use for design teams and agencies.
- Extended Commercial License: $159; up to 8 activated devices. Includes mass production and authorized digital resale under the license terms.
- All three are lifetime licenses with free v1.x updates.

## Product and official sources

- [Product, pricing and FAQ](https://andrewr.online/arrangemaster/)
- [Documentation](https://andrewr.online/arrangemaster/documentation.html)
- [Full 24-hour trial](https://andrewr.online/arrangemaster/trial/)

Methods include Grid Layout, Bounds Packing, Dense Packing and Shape Respect. Single Item Fill repeats one design; Disperse spreads objects across a container. Requires internet for activation, license checks and engine downloads.

Arrange Master PRO is a separate subscription product. Its Solo, Studio and Team plans must not be confused with the lifetime licenses above. Its official address remains https://arrangemasterpro.andrewr.online/.

License prices and device limits updated 31 October 2026.
